prompt: Objective: set the price of a new movie theater recliner seat. What you've learned: customers would pay about $5 more than for a standard seat. Latest finding: the recliner takes the space of two standard seats. What is the best next step?

options.text: Compare the recliner with the two seats it replaces
options.feedback: Right. The recliner takes two seats' space, so it must earn more than both.

options.text: Survey customers again on what they would pay
Estimate the cost of buying and installing the recliners
options.feedback: Secondary: the bigger issue is the seats it displaces.

options.text: Calculate revenue at $5 above a standard seat
options.feedback: That misses the finding: the recliner replaces two seats, so $5 more than one seat earns less than two.

explanation: The recliner displaces two seats, so its price must beat what those two seats earn.
